public_health_question.v: What changes to ACIP's recommended immunization schedule for children and adolescents aged 18 years or younger take effect for 2024?

ev.q: The 2024 immunization schedule includes several changes to the cover page, tables, notes, and appendix from the 2023 immunization schedule.
include new or updated recommendations for influenza vaccine ( 3 ), pneumococcal vaccines ( 4 )

respiratory syncytial virus monoclonal antibody (RSV-mAb) ( 5 ), respiratory syncytial virus vaccines (RSV) ( 6 )
administering a one-time, lifetime IPV booster to adolescents aged 18 years who have completed the primary series
A new row was added for Jynneos with the column for age 18 years highlighted in purple
meningococcal serogroups A, B, C, W, Y vaccine (MenACWY-TT/MenB-FHbp)

equity.level_reason: A schedule with no data; age only defines the population (children and adolescents aged ≤18 years), and health equity is mentioned only as a general consideration in ACIP reviews.

level_alternative.reason: 'Impact on health equity' is named as a criterion of ACIP reviews, which could be read as raising equity in a general way.

notes: An annual schedule update listing changes to tables, notes and appendix; it reports no quantities. The conditions are the targets of vaccines with new or changed recommendations; the list is not exhaustive.
